resources.name: Lume Backend Only
resources.description: Colecao backend-only com setup/auth reais, capability APIs, produto, billing, FinOps e cenarios de validacao.

resources.name: GET Health [happy path]
resources.description: Healthcheck basico do backend.

resources.name: GET Setup Status [happy path]
resources.description: Verifica se a aplicacao exige bootstrap inicial.

resources.name: POST Bootstrap [only if setup pending]
resources.description: Executar apenas quando `setupRequired=true`. A resposta cria sessao no cookie jar.

resources.name: POST Login [happy path]
resources.description: Login real. Mantem a sessao no cookie jar do Insomnia.

resources.name: GET Session [happy path]
resources.description: Confirma a sessao autenticada.

resources.name: POST Logout [auth reset]
resources.description: Limpa a sessao atual.

resources.name: POST Activate Workspace [happy path]
resources.description: Ativa o workspace apontado na env.

resources.name: POST Create Member [happy path]
resources.description: Copie o `id` retornado para `memberId` se quiser encadear o PATCH.

resources.name: PATCH Update Member [happy path]
resources.description: Atualiza o membro referenciado em `memberId`.

resources.name: POST Connectivity Test [provider dependent]
resources.description: Executa o teste de conectividade do provider selecionado.
